summary: Windows private-file checks call cliutil.VerifyCredsPerms, so the POSIX helper, the Windows owner/DACL helper, and the shared SDDL evaluator must all be present.
reason: platform/perms_windows.go delegates to cliutil.VerifyCredsPerms, but this print omitted the generator's credential-permission files. GOOS=windows fails with undefined: cliutil.VerifyCredsPerms. A regen must keep a VerifyCredsPerms implementation on both windows and non-windows, including the SDDL evaluator the Windows helper calls.
validated_outcome: GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 and arm64 builds succeed, as do native, darwin/arm64, go vet, and go test.
